messages.subject: remote console on rj console server inside a docker inside boot2docker inside OSX
messages.subject_clean: remote console on rj console server inside a docker inside boot2docker inside OSX
messages.body_plain:
Hello Stephan,

Now that everything runs great on linux, I am experimenting on OSX.
The 1099 port is bound in the VM running on a local (virtual) IP
(boot2docker ip).

I can configure a Manual statet remote console using SSH tunneling (there's
a ssh server running in the VM), and it works, but there is a big lag,
especially in browser() mode, before printing the prompt.

Can I connect to the rj console server without the ssh tunnel ?
(I tried without success)
Do you think this lag can be due to the ssh overhead ?


Thanks,
Karl

messages.subject: Re: "Tasks" in StatET (vs "Tasks" in C)
messages.body_plain:
Hi Alex,

[2014-11-25 05:36] Alex wrote:
> Hello Stephan and everyone!
>
> Based on my experience with C, when Eclipse detects such a tag as "XXX,"
> or "TODO," or "FIXME" in comments to the code, it automatically adds a
> task to the Tasks pane.
>
> In StatET, this feature is not automatic (at least in my case).

This feature exists in StatET since version 0.2.0:

http://www.walware.de/?page=/it/statet/log.01.html&jump=tasktags

Please note the note, it works only in R files in R projects.

Regards,
Stephan

>
> Regards,
> Alex

messages.subject: org.Hs.eg.db crashes StatET
messages.body_plain:
First reported here (last post): https://support.bioconductor.org/p/63150/

This:

require(org.Hs.eg.db)

crashes inside StaET rj console, but not in the standard console.

Error message:
Error: org.Hs.egPFAM is defunct. Please use select() if you need access to
  PFAM or PROSITE accessions.
#
# A fatal error has been detected by the Java Runtime Environment:
#
#  SIGSEGV (0xb) at pc=0x00007fab1718dfd2, pid=40, tid=140371141064448
#
# JRE version: OpenJDK Runtime Environment (7.0_65-b32) (build 1.7.0_65-b32)
# Java VM: OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (24.65-b04 mixed mode linux-amd64
compressed oops)
# Problematic frame:
# V  [libjvm.so+0x2a2fd2]


Experienced with R-3.1.1 on linux and on boot2docker on macOsX.
StatET 3.4.0b201407171807E43sw
Eclise 4.4.0

I'll try to dig a little to see what exact instruction crashes the console.

Best,
Karl
